test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which state does Brahmaputra river enters when it takes U turn at Namcha Barwa?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Arunachal Pradesh__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Namcha Barwa** is a mountain peak in** Tibetian Himalayas **with a height of **7757 meters**.
 
• The Tsangpo - Brahmaputra river takes a U-turn on reaching the **Namcha Barwa **and enters India in **Arunachal Pradesh** through a gorge.
 
• Here, it is called the **Dihang and it is joined by the Dibang**, the Lohit, and many other tributaries to form the **Brahmaputra in Assam.**
 
• The undercutting done by this river is of the order of** 5500 meters.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​****The Tlawng** is a river in **Mizoram, **northeastern India. Its tributaries include **the Tut, Teirei, and the Ngashih. **
 
• **The city of Aizawl lies in the Tlawng valley.**
 
• **The Brahmaputra** is the main river and the lifeline of** Assam**; it has thirteen tributaries.
 
• The major rivers of Nagaland are **Doyang, Dikhu, Dhansiri, Tizu, Milak, Dzu, Langlong, Zungki, Likimro, Lanye and Dzuza**. There are other lesser known rivers in Nagaland such as Manglu, Tsurong, Nanung, Tsurang or Disai, Tsumok, Menung etc.
